newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora says might close Corbehem cardboard.
newsitem.headline: Stora says might close Corbehem cardboard.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora AB said on Friday it is considering closing its cardboard plant at Stora Corbehem in France.

The restructuring measures including the possibility that the cardboard plant is closed. If that happens Stora Corbehem could be forced to reduce its staff of 1,300 by 180 people, the company said in a statement.
Stora Corbehem mainly manufactures coated magazine paper, LWC, while cardboard makes up a small part of production, Stora said.
Stora said discussions about a restructuring plan for Stora Corbehem started on Friday.
